{{Otheruses|Coruscant Museum}}
The '''New Republic Historical Archive''' was a museum established on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

''[[Thrive or Die]]'', the memoirs of the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known only as the [[Bloodletter]] was put on display there when it was released.<ref name="Coruscant: Center of the Empire">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030403coruscant|text=Coruscant: Center of the Empire|int=Coruscant: Center of the Empire}}</ref> Additionally, the [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] report [[Tauntaun Feathers A1]] was donated to the Archive by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Hoth: Under the Ice, Part 4: A Brief Thaw">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031218hoth4|series=Hoth: Under the Ice|text=Part 4: A Brief Thaw}}</ref>
